new_gain.name: exact disjoint Z_{3,2/3} gluing and countable stopping-time randomized-band restart
new_gain.status: CANDIDATE_FULL / SELF-CHECKED / PENDING INDEPENDENT REVIEW for the mechanism theorem; parent endpoint remains PARTIAL / OPEN
new_gain.gluing: If a measure space of total mass T is partitioned into E_j of masses T_j and f_j is supported in E_j with ||f_j||_{Z_{3,2/3}(E_j)} <= K A_j^(1/3), then ||sum_j f_j||_{Z_{3,2/3}(T)} <= K (sum_j A_j)^(1/3), with constant exactly 1 and countably many pieces allowed.
new_gain.restart_zero_seed: At any stopping time tau, an F_tau-measurable countable choice of spectral band with uniform condition ratio K, followed for a deterministic restart horizon H by progressive forcing confined to the chosen band and zero restarted state, satisfies the same critical endpoint constant 65 sqrt(K), independent of the number or separation of possible bands.
new_gain.restart_nonzero_seed: If the F_tau-measurable restart seed is also confined to the chosen band, then the restarted solution satisfies ||Z||_{Z_{3,2/3}} <= 2(1+log 2)^(2/3) [H E||x||^3 + (65 sqrt(K))^3 E int ||Y||^3]^(1/3).
new_gain.passive_seed_identity: For dU=-AU dt+A^(1/2)U dW, E_tau||U_t||^3 <= ||U_0||^3, by spectral Jensen and E exp(3 sqrt(lambda)B_t-9 lambda t/2)=1.
new_gain.connection: Removes all countable packet-choice entropy at a stopping-time restart. Therefore the remaining full-endpoint obstruction is not the number or spectral separation of candidate packets, but within-excursion/pathwise packet migration before a genuine restart; this matches and sharpens the predecessor active-migration slack target.

proof_core.tail_jensen: For local tail masses s_j and L_j=1+log(T_j/s_j), local endpoint gives A_j >= R^3 s_j/(K^3 L_j^2). With w_j=s_j/s and e^(L-1)=sum w_j e^(L_j-1), Jensen gives sum w_j L_j<=L and sum w_j/L_j^2>=1/(sum w_j L_j)^2>=1/L^2, hence R^3 s<=K^3(sum A_j)L^2.
proof_core.conditioning_scaling: On branch probability pi, local H,u,A scale to pi H, pi u, pi A; the logarithm log(H/u) and the critical Z-ratio are invariant.

residual_obstruction: Control packet changes while the solution stays at high level, i.e. before a true restart. The current approximate packet migration slack supplies an active forcing charge, and passive Hellinger/decoherence supplies an off-input charge, but a stopping-time center-change Carleson estimate joining them is still missing.
failed_routes_preserved: Generic simultaneous block square-function gluing loses N^(1/6) and does not close the full endpoint.
L^2 packet localization alone does not control instantaneous Rayleigh quotients because arbitrarily high-frequency leakage can have small L^2 mass; a time-integrated migration argument is required.
next_attack: Use the exact restart/gluing theorem to define high-level excursion restart times. Prove that any change of the selected three-block packet before the next downcrossing incurs either the predecessor joint-slack active-migration charge or the passive Hellinger charge; sum those center changes without a packet-count entropy factor.
